skills.name: mageflow_generate
skills.description: Generate or edit images via Mage-Flow (Microsoft 4B text-to-image + instruction-edit model) through the live HuggingFace Space mage-flow-community/mage-flow, executed on a remote Linux host over SSH. Free ZeroGPU quota; needs a HuggingFace read token and an SSH-reachable host with gradio_client installed. v2 fixes six bugs in v1: SSH key/config discovery, the dead microsoft/mage-flow Space, the /False vs /generate endpoint name, the gradio_client >=2 hf_token->token rename, the wrong publish directory, and hardcoded credentials.
skills.author: tobia
